Approved evidence

Kili Technology

org.kili_technology

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. The proposed supplier category is customer-expert annotation, evaluation and post-training software, with an external specialist partner network. Tasks include specialist judgments, post-training examples, NLP tags, image masks and audio/transcription workflows. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
